x: Our usual good start looked decidedly iffy as Mick Jones slipped around the waterlogged hammer circle. Going into the last round in an unusual second spot only Mick seemed confident that he could retain his 3 year unbeaten record.

Our start was as usual excellent with a lack lustre win from Mick Jones in the hammer. Mick was still recovering from four week absence due to injury and was spending his time going from meet to meet in search of the big one.
And performances don't come any more meritorious than those set by the man who has aptly been described as one of the most popular men in our sport - hammer man Mick Jones.

Australian Marty Dent had a cracking run in the 3000 metres Steeplechase - first man home after the Kenyan clean sweep – and in his fifth Commonwealth Games Mick Jones went over 70 metres in the hammer to place 5th.
